mo.per.long: Long history from 2023 (excluding Kraken and Gemini)
mo.chart.share.unit: per cent of volumes against all fiat currencies, weekly data
mo.chart.vol: Volumes against the euro in absolute terms
mo.chart.vol.unit: billions of stablecoin units (roughly dollars) per week
mo.rule: Rule: gap of more than 2 standard deviations over the previous 52 weeks, for both the EUR share and the volume against the euro, with the same sign. "To be checked" when only one of the two gaps exceeds 2.
